$comment: The retry after a guard refusal (design 02 § the operation record; client/ops.go): the guard fires before dedup, so a retried guarded append surfaces wrong-last-sequence even when the first attempt landed. The SDK reads the subject's last op and compares IDs: equal means the earlier attempt landed and the refusal was dedup's echo (report the landed ack); different means the thing moved (report thing-moved: re-read, re-validate, retry).
